findings.description: MustHold denotes an explicit normative requirement, while Holds denotes assigned satisfaction. Static metadata is not deontic necessity, actual compliance, temporal preservation or a selected premise asserting every target.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner must confirm normative denotation and the exact compliance/preservation profile.

findings.description: System-owned state/transition/decision/transformation points and their scope are a candidate abstraction. Declared points, reachable states, transition closure and actual program/artifact binding are distinct denominators.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and system owners must select subject, scope, initial states, transitions and frame/exit policy.

findings.description: Can violate requires a possible countermodel/behavior interpretation, not an existential actual breach in T. Scoped unsatisfaction is a candidate breach abbreviation; drift versus defect diagnosis needs an admitted evaluator.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner must confirm possibility and diagnostic mappings without making correct implementations impossible.

findings.description: Grounded/operationalized/enforced relationships are retained as open contracts. Should-trace guidance, declared enforcers, actual enforcement and selected Gate meanings are not interchangeable.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner, Constitution and Gate owners must decide required references and actual enforcer/owner contracts.

findings.description: Source claims four specific generic children and distinguishes other roles. Private candidate tags do not prove cross-source type exclusions, subtype inclusions or real carrier compatibility.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and the exact four child owners must review carrier alignments, scope and inclusion obligations.
